head_commit.message:
370: scorecard state on every published model, matched-stock CSV export, consistency tests

- spacr.model_zoo.scorecard_state / scorecard_state_text: reviewed, held_out,
  recorded at publication or not yet evaluated. spaCR-published rows that are
  not reviewed say so in the Model Zoo tooltip, detail panel (card viewer
  fallback), picker row tooltip and picker card; stock/third-party rows keep
  their own description.
- Zoo data gaps closed from existing measurements: toxoplasma_from_hoechst_v1
  gets its metrics dict (from its notes); nuclei_from_cellmask_v1 stock values
  (from its notes). SVG cards unchanged.
- spacr.model_zoo.scorecard_export_rows and docs/models/scorecards.csv
  (written by tools/build_model_cards.py via spacr.tabular), plus a Scorecard
  column in docs/models/README.md and a state line on every card.
- tests/test_f370_scorecard_states_and_export.py: card JSON = zoo export,
  export = SVG score-card numbers, CSV current, states.
- 2 captions with AI-reviewed records in nine languages (no native-speaker
  signoff); catalogs rebuilt, caption arrivals refreshed, API sources and
  Help index regenerated; 3 public symbols in a dated API arrival contract.
- Item 370: BUILT note and status; GPU re-scores, dataset upload, native GUI
  check and sign-off assigned to WS / maintainer.

head_commit.message:
698: model-scale flows no longer fail hosted PV runs; worker ValueErrors reach the visitor

Pathogen models (toxoplasma_pv, toxoplasma_from_cellmask, toxoplasma_from_hoechst)
run with resample off, so Cellpose returns flows and cell probability at the
model scale. build_result_zip refused them (ValueError 'flows must have shape
(2, Y, X)'), and ZeroGPU showed visitors only 'ValueError'. The adapter now
marks them unavailable with the same reason as the browser route, and the
Space turns request ValueErrors into gr.Error so their text is shown.
